name: Fellowship
summary: SKSE plugin for Skyrim: travel with up to 20 followers and 20 animal companions using the vanilla follower dialogue
description:
[center][/center]
Fellowship removes the one-follower cap and changes [b]almost nothing else[/b]

[line]


[size=4][b]Feature[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]Up to 20 followers[/b][/color], default 5. Hirelings included.[/*]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]Up to 20 animal companions[/b][/color] too, default 5, with a separate count for dogs and other pets.[/*]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]Other follower systems left alone[/b][/color]: companions with their own systems, like Inigo or Lucien, aren't listed or counted, and join on top of your limit.[/*]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]No free hunting bow[/b][/color]: followers no longer get the hunting bow and iron arrows the base game hands them when they join.[/*]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]Calm everyone down[/b][/color]: one button to end a party brawl.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Optional extras[/b] [i](all off by default)[/i]

[list]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]No friendly fire[/b][/color]: nobody in the party can hurt anyone, and nobody turns on you.[/*]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]Gold sharing[/b][/color]: every follower takes a cut of what you sell to merchants (5% each by default, never more than half). A bigger party means smaller earnings. Followers with their own systems take a cut too, while they're near you.[/*]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]Follower homes[/b][/color]: tell a follower or your dog [i]"This is your home now."[/i] Once dismissed, they walk there and live around it, in any house, inn or camp. [i]"Forget the home I gave you."[/i] sends them back to their own.[/*]
[*][color=#8fb4d9][b]Sandbox[/b][/color]: your party relaxes around you when you stand still for a while, or the whole time you're inside an inn or player home. Each has its own toggle.[/*]
[/list]


[size=2][color=#9a9a9a]With No friendly fire on, the one thing it can't block is two followers hitting each other with weapons; their spells are blocked, and any fight between them is calmed at once.[/color][/size]


[line]


[size=4][b]Settings[/b][/size]

[i]Mod Control Panel > Fellowship[/i] (SKSE Menu Framework), or [i]SKSE/Plugins/Fellowship.ini[/i].


[line]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][url=https://skse.silverlock.org/]SKSE[/url][/*]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/32444]Address Library for SKSE Plugins[/url][/*]
[*][i]Recommended:[/i] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/skyrimspecialedition/mods/120352]SKSE Menu Framework[/url] (without it, use the INI)[/*]
[/list]

[size=2][color=#9a9a9a]Tested on Skyrim AE 1.6.1170. Built for SE and AE; VR is untested.[/color][/size]

[line]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[color=#e07b67][b]Not compatible with other multiple-follower mods[/b][/color] (NFF, EFF, AFT, Multiple Followers Framework, Simple Follower Framework...). Use one.

Fellowship edits one base-game record, the follower quest ([i]DialogueFollower[/i]), and includes the Unofficial Patch's fixes to it. If another mod that touch this then it will need a patch (let me know).

[line]

[size=4][b]FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]"You already have someone with you"?[/b]
Your party is full: you've reached [b]Max followers[/b]. Followers with their own systems don't count. The party list in the menu shows who does.

[b]Will lowering the limit dismiss anyone?[/b]
No. You just can't recruit until you're below it again.

[b]Does my dog count?[/b]
No. Pets have a separate count: up to [b]Max animals[/b] (default 5) travel alongside your followers without taking anyone's place.

[b]A dismissed dog won't come back with me?[/b]
That's the base game: each animal has its own way back. Meeko and Dawnguard's dogs can simply be asked again, Vigilance must be bought again from Banning in Markarth, and the stray dog joins only once. Fellowship leaves all of that as it is.

[b]I don't see "This is your home now."[/b]
Turn on [b]Follower homes[/b] in the menu's [b]Extra[/b] tab, then [b]save and load that save once[/b]. The line only shows for followers and animals recruited the vanilla way: companions with their own systems (Inigo, Lucien, ...) keep their own home rules.

[b]Do my followers get the gold from Gold sharing?[/b]
No. Their cut just comes off your price, so there's no gold in their inventory to take back.

[b]A follower turned on me.[/b]
Press [b]Calm everyone down[/b]. With No friendly fire off, they also leave, as in the base game; ask them back once they've cooled off.

[b]Install or remove mid-game?[/b]
Installing: any time (save and load once if you want the home lines right away). Removing: dismiss all but one follower and forget any homes you gave, save, then uninstall.

[b]Will you add more features?[/b]
Most likely not. Fellowship is meant to stay small. If an idea really fits, I might add it, but it will always be optional and off by default.

[b]Reporting a bug[/b]
Turn on [b]Verbose log[/b] in the menu's [b]Debug[/b] tab, reproduce the problem, and post your [i]Documents/My Games/Skyrim Special Edition/SKSE/Fellowship.log[/i] (via Pastebin) in the [b]Bugs[/b] tab with what you did and what you expected.

[line]
